payload.title: Export extension-authoring types from @frick/server index
payload.description: Apps that register policyHooks + blobProcessors via createFrickServer can't import the types to author them — they're referenced by ServerOptions but not exported from apps/server/src/index.ts, forcing workarounds like 'type Hook = NonNullable<ServerOptions["policyHooks"]>[number]' and 'type Proc = NonNullable<ServerOptions["blobProcessors"]>[number]'. Add to the package index (pure additive, no behavior change): from authz.ts — FrickPolicyHook, FrickPolicyInput, FrickDecision, FrickDecisionReason, FrickAction, Principal, deny, ALLOW; from blobs/processor.ts — FrickBlobProcessor, FrickBlobValidateContext, FrickBlobValidationResult, FrickBlobProcessContext, FrickBlobProcessResult, FrickBlobProcessorRegistry. CHANGELOG entry. Verified need: aquarius-os backend (AQ-28 policy hooks, AQ-53 blob processor) derived these via ServerOptions indexing.
